A customer reported that they could not find today's OpenJDK 121.0.10 on the JBoss Downloads site.

We have had the same issue inthe past when versions hit "10", "20", etc. Is there any way to fix this permanently so it doesn't keep happening?

Initial Collaboration Doc: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1L-Hy_M9pLfkfDbChZeYDaktlR3LA_CBUyEuN12uMT5c] 
h1. Project Description 
h2. Summary 

The Red Hat Content Gateway application has been identified as a candidate within UXE to further the broader corporate initiative to utilize the partnership between IBM/Red Hat and Adobe.

As such, several departments across the organization will need to work together to define available opportunities and implementation options.
h2. Goals 

Goals of this initiative include: 
 # Identify opportunities to integrate Adobe Experience Manager services into the Red Hat Content Gateway application.
 # Document where further discovery is needed.
 # Initialize associated ADRs.
 # Create and link project related Epics do document all lower-level discovery and implementation tickets.

h2. Non-goals 
 # Implementation of migration efforts

h2. Requirements

This is super WIP and just a brain dump of a possible roadmap of what came out of the call on 7/26/24
h3. Phase 1
 # Migrate marketing reporting from Eloqua to Adobe

Roger's notes:

The actual action for this phase is that Brent Baker would talk to the marketing folks and make sure that they are no longer using Eloqua for analytics and instead using Adobe, by either:
 # Already getting the same data in both systems and move to generating reports from Adobe instead Eloqua (which I _think_ he said was most of them)
 # Changing any/all data gathering/input sources to point to/use Adobe instead of Eloqua

This is a manual procedural step that can be taken by the marketing team to eliminate the need for CG to support multiple external integrations. My understanding is that this is already something that needs to happen anyway as everyone is shifting to Adobe and away from Eloqua. So, it _should be_ an easy win.
h3. Phase 2
 # Migrate CG asset management to AEM

h3. Phase 3
 # Feature migration discovery
 # SSO & Authentication
 # End-user permissions management
 # Content manager permissions
 # Content management interface
 # Separation of file management by project/property

h3. Phase 4 (if needed)
 # Implement any feature migrations deemed viable from discovery

h2. Measurements

These are some initial ideas. Needs more input on what’s possible to gather, measure and report.
 # Download speeds and/or uptime in phase 2
 # User satisfaction before & after
 # Possible in Phase 1 & 4

h2. Workstream dependencies
 * UXE AP Business Stakeholders 
 * UXE AP Tech Leads (representing all work streams across UXE)

h2. Delivery dates 
 *  Delivery dates will be defined after project definition is accepted and work is scoped. 

h2. Resources
h3. Initial call
 # Video:
 # [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QW9uKOYfM25IiF4PDk8RqZtiV0dqoM3B/view] 

 # Transcript:
 # [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Jr-zPFX4OPxlf_j9Fq18DaFZJMdUtxnua2TRYh17cSc/edit]

h2. Project is ready for work when: 

❎ UXE Business stakeholders are aligned on project criteria. 

❎ The project is prioritized by UXE Business stakeholders. This is signaled by the project (initiative) moving into the 'prioritized' column.

❎ The project is resourced. Once resourced, the project (initiative) will move into the 'in progress' column.
